news.title: 贝克汉姆怒了 索赔2.7亿 自己高端形象被损害
news.summary: 贝克汉姆的商业公司 DB Ventures 在美国法院起诉长期合作的香水公司 Coty，指对方把以他名字命名的香水卖进英国平价连锁 “一镑店”…

content.v: 贝克汉姆的商业公司 DB Ventures 在美国法院起诉长期合作的香水公司 Coty，指对方把以他名字命名的香水卖进英国平价连锁 “一镑店” 和加油站，要求赔偿 4100 万美元（约2.7亿元人民币）。
诉状里说，得知自家香水出现在加油站货架上时，公司方面 “震惊且沮丧”，质疑这种铺货是怎么发生的。律师把责任归到 Coty 的 “绝望与贪婪”，认为低价渠道已经伤害了贝克汉姆多年经营的高端形象。诉状还强调，他是全球最具代表性的体育、时尚和商业人物之一，2025 年获英国授予爵士勋衔，品牌价值一直和品质绑定。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201431301397.png
Coty 过去为他推出过 45 款同名香水，每瓶约 20 英镑。双方矛盾其实早有前兆：贝克汉姆方面此前就指控 Coty 通过未经核准的渠道卖了约 2400 万美元的货，并低报销售额 1.23 亿美元，导致 DB Ventures 少收约 600 万美元权利金。这次索赔把两项合并计算。

Coty 已请求法院驳回诉讼。它否认香水曾在 “一镑店” 出售，并称按合同自己有权决定销售渠道，只有超市和大型量贩店需要事先取得 DB Ventures 同意。Coty 的另一种说法更直接：这场官司不是为了保护品牌形象，而是 DB Ventures 想提前解约，好把授权转给竞争对手 Interparfums。事实上，持有贝克汉姆品牌名称的 Authentic Brands Group 已在 2025 年接触 Interparfums，双方今年 1 月宣布达成协议，预计明年 1 月生效。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201431594963.png
诉状顺带曝光了合约里的待遇条款：按 2016 年签的授权协议，Coty 安排贝克汉姆宣传香水时，要负担他本人、两名随行人员和一名保安的头等舱机票、餐饮与住宿，每次活动最多 6 小时，发型和妆容准备时间也算在内；他从香水销售中拿的提成比例是 7%。

news.title: 明知能多一半销量 GTA为什么首发不上PC呢？

content.v: 2026年11月19日，《GTA 6》正式发售。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/19/origin_202611191128401087.jpg
但如果你在这一天打开Steam或Epic商城，搜索栏里找不到这款游戏的商店页面。早在11月5日，R星发布发售前夕公告时就写得很清楚：首发平台只有PS5和Xbox Series X|S。
让PC玩家更难接受的细节出现在11月10日。微软宣布《GTA 6》首发支持Xbox Cloud Gaming云游戏服务，连发布于十多年前的Xbox One老主机，都能通过云端串流运行这部新作。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/19/origin_202611191128568416.jpg
但这项服务专门屏蔽了Windows电脑和手机端的入口。换句话说，PC玩家连花钱租云端服务器曲线游玩的路子也被堵死了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/19/origin_202611191129054534.jpg
这看起来很反常。半年前的2026年5月，R星母公司Take-Two的CEO施特劳斯·泽尔尼克在接受彭博社采访时亲口算过一笔账：如今一款顶级3A大作，PC端的销量可以占到总销量的45%到50%。明知道电脑玩家手里攥着接近一半的销量，R星和Take-Two为什么还是选择在首发日把这批人挡在门外？
PS5 Pro 都锁死30帧，把游戏搬上PC到底卡在哪？
《GTA 6》发售前两天，技术评测机构Digital Foundry公布了早期性能分析：这款游戏在所有本世代主机上都锁死在30帧，连性能更强的PS5 Pro也一样，开发团队甚至没能做出一个40帧模式。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/19/origin_202611191129121759.jpg
卡住帧率的主要部件是CPU，显卡倒还有余量。根据Digital Foundry的拆解，《GTA 6》在罪恶都市里塞进了极高密度的NPC、复杂的交通调度和实时物理模拟，这些运算几乎吃光了本世代主机的处理器性能。
PC Gamer编辑在11月18日发表的100小时试玩评测中也提到，主机版虽然体量惊人，但受限于硬件帧率，能明显感觉到这款游戏未来在高性能电脑上会顺畅得多。
连固定硬件的主机都已经被压榨到极限，同步开发PC版的工程难度就会成倍放大。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/19/origin_202611191129207429.jpg
曾参与《GTA 5》和《荒野大镖客2》开发的前R星动画师迈克·约克此前解释过内部的真实处境：主机平台只有PS5、PS5 Pro、Xbox Series X和Series S这几套完全固定的硬件配置，研发和测试人员可以把全部精力压上去，对着同一套规格死磕到底。
一旦把游戏搬上PC，情况就彻底变了。电脑玩家手里有成千上万种CPU、显卡、内存、主板和驱动程序的排列组合。迈克·约克直言，哪怕公司内部养着一千名测试员，也根本测不完玩家家里所有的硬件搭配。
业内开发者在接受Mashable采访时也提到，先在性能受限的主机上把游戏做稳，再往高配电脑上扩容，在工程上远比双端同步推进容易掌控。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/19/origin_202611191129266151.jpg
迈克·约克在解释这一点时，特意拿2015年的《蝙蝠侠：阿卡姆骑士》当反面教材。那款大作当年同步发售了PC版，结果因为严重的掉帧和闪退，发售后几天就被迫从Steam暂时下架并开放退款。
对于《GTA 6》这样耗时近十年、全行业盯着看的超级项目，首发一旦因为PC端优化翻车，损失远比推迟几个月更大。
主机先卖一轮、 PC 再卖一轮，这笔二次收割的账怎么算？
翻开时间线，《GTA 5》在2013年9月登陆PS3和Xbox 360，2014年11月登陆PS4和Xbox One，直到2015年4月才上线PC，主机与PC之间整整隔了19个月。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/19/origin_202611191129314300.jpg
哪怕是2022年3月推出的PS5增强版，也让电脑玩家苦等了整整三年，直到2025年3月才登陆PC。《荒野大镖客2》也是同样的路数，2018年10月首发主机，13个月后的2019年11月才卖给PC玩家。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/19/origin_202611191129371743.jpg
绝口不提PC版的发售日期，在商业上有一笔非常实在的算盘。如果R星提前宣布PC版明年春天就上，大批电脑玩家就会安心观望。
反之，在官方保持沉默的情况下，很多等不及的PC玩家会在首发期妥协，去买一台PS5或者在已有主机上先买一份。等到日后PC版带着高帧率、高画质和Mod支持推出时，这批人里会有相当一部分再掏第二次钱。
这笔账和Take-Two的财报结构高度契合。
2026年11月9日，Take-Two公布了2027财年第二季度财报，预计2027财年全年净预订量将达到80亿至82亿美元，并透露《GTA 6》的预购量已经远超公司预期。财报里另一个值得注意的数字是，公司高达81%的净预订量来自持续性消费，也就是在线模式和游戏内购。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/19/origin_202611191129432719.jpg
把单机首发和PC版错开，正好帮Take-Two拉出两波销售高峰。2026年底先靠主机单机版引爆第一波销量和话题；等主机热度稍退，再把PC版和未来的《GTA 6》在线模式打包推出来，接力引爆第二波。R星早在2023年8月就收购了PC端最大的角色扮演Mod团队Cfx.re（FiveM）。
泽尔尼克在11月9日接受TweakTown和GamesIndustry.biz采访时，多次提到角色扮演社区的盈利潜力。主机负责首发冲销量，PC搭配在线模式和角色扮演社区负责长线赚钱，两头分工明确。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/19/origin_202611191129498389.jpg
这里需要顺手澄清一个流传很广的误解：很多人以为《GTA 6》首发不上PC，是因为索尼花重金买了主机限时独占。泽尔尼克已经公开否认了这种说法。
根据TimeSaver和GameLuster等媒体的梳理，索尼和Take-Two签的是营销推广协议，内容包括PlayStation商店首页霸屏、预告片画面录制平台合作以及主机广告推广；在售价上，PS5和Xbox版本的标准版与豪华版同为79.99美元和99.99美元。
决定首发跳过PC的是R星自己，索尼并没有买断平台。
除了卖两遍，安全与保密也是R星绕不开的考量。游戏一旦在发售首日上线PC，就会立刻暴露在破解组织、外挂制作者和解包玩家面前。单机盗版会直接切走首发黄金期的正版销量，而游戏文件在第一天被数据挖掘，会把隐藏剧情、未实装的线上模式地图和彩蛋全部提前抖落出来。
先在相对封闭的主机环境里卖完第一轮，能把首发期的泄密和盗版风险压到最低。
AI 逆向工程逼近，R星这次还能让PC玩家等一年多吗？
主机先行、PC殿后这套打法，R星用了二十年，次次灵验。但在2026年底，外面的环境已经变了，R星这次很可能拖不起一两年。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/19/origin_202611191129576843.jpg
2026年10月13日，游戏商业媒体GamesBeat援引四位熟悉R星计划的行业信源报道称，《GTA 6》的PC版计划大幅提前，目标窗口锁定在2027年第一季度，也就是明年1月到3月之间。IGN、Eurogamer和Tom's Hardware随后都跟进了这条消息。
需要明确的是，R星官方至今没有确认这一日期，目前它仍属于行业爆料。但如果消息属实，PC玩家的等待时间将从过去的13到19个月，骤减到2到4个月。
R星为什么突然坐不住了？一个过去从未出现过的新威胁正在逼近：生成式AI辅助逆向工程。
2026年11月6日，前R星北方技术总监奥贝·弗美伊（Obbe Vermeij）在接受媒体采访时发出警告。他指出，如今的黑客完全有可能拿到PS5版的《GTA 6》游戏文件后，花上几万美元的算力成本，动用生成式AI工具进行代码逆向，强行拼出一个能在PC上运行的非官方移植版。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/19/origin_202611191130027206.jpg
哪怕这个版本画质粗糙、漏洞百出，只要它在官方PC版缺席的空窗期流传开来，就会分走大量玩家和实打实的收入。
Take-Two高层对这个威胁的反应相当罕见。11月9日，IGN记者当面问起泽尔尼克，如何看待黑客用AI克隆和逆向游戏，以及大模型公司Anthropic近期封禁Claude用于逆向游戏代码的新闻。泽尔尼克没有像往常那样轻描淡写。
主机市场自身的增长见顶，也让R星很难再像十年前那样从容。市场调研机构Newzoo在2026年11月17日发布的报告指出，欧美主机玩家规模从2022年起就已经趋于停滞，欧美主机游戏收入占全球游戏市场总收入的比例，也从2015年的21.5%一路降到了2025年的17.1%。
想要靠《GTA 6》把营收推向新高度，Take-Two比过去任何时候都更需要PC市场。
长期缺席官方PC版，还已经开始反噬品牌安全。网络安全机构NordVPN在11月18日发出预警，由于大量电脑玩家急着找资源，暗网和各类下载站上已经出现大批伪装成GTA 6 PC破解版的恶意软件安装包。拖延的时间越长，假冒资源带来的负面影响和盗版分流风险就越大。
所以， GTA 6 首发缺席PC，到底是一次技术妥协还是一场精明算计？

回到开头的问题：明知道PC能卖出一半销量，《GTA 6》首发还是把电脑玩家挡在门外，原因同时来自技术和生意两头。在工程上，连PS5 Pro都被CPU压到锁死30帧，R星必须把全部研发和测试人力死死按在主机上，避免像《蝙蝠侠：阿卡姆骑士》那样因为PC硬件碎片化在首发日砸了招牌；在商业上，封锁PC端既能挡住首发期的破解盗版和文件解包，又能靠时间差逼出主机+PC的二次购买，顺理成章地为未来的在线模式和角色扮演社区留出第二波营收高峰。
全世界的游戏公司里，只有像《GTA》这样十年磨一剑、几乎没有替代品的超级作品，才有底气让占近半销量的电脑玩家在门外排队。
不过，这种底气能撑多久，很快就会迎来检验。
2027年第一季度就是一个清晰的观察节点：如果R星真的打破持续二十年的惯例，把《GTA 6》的PC版提前到明年春天发售，那就说明在主机增长见顶和AI逆向技术的双重倒逼下，哪怕是R星，也再没法像过去那样让PC玩家苦等一年半了。

news.title: 育碧更新《刺客信条侠隐》近况！秦朝背景 未来可期
news.summary: 《刺客信条：侠隐》是一款以中国秦朝为背景的作品，由育碧和腾讯旗下的Level Infinite合作打造，登陆移动端。游戏最初于2022年正式…

content.v: 《刺客信条：侠隐》是一款以中国秦朝为背景的作品，由育碧和腾讯旗下的Level Infinite合作打造，登陆移动端。游戏最初于2022年正式公布，期间偶有泄露和爆料，但至今仍未推出。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201415468903.jpg
据Insider Gaming报道，在育碧近期的财报电话会议上，育碧首席财务官弗雷德里克·杜盖（Frédérick Duguet）提及了即将推出的手游《刺客信条：侠隐》，并确认游戏仍在开发当中。
据报道，弗雷德里克·杜盖在谈及手游业务时，将《刺客信条：侠隐》作为公司的相关项目之一。他表示：“从长期财务回报来看，考虑到我们希望更加注重资本配置和财务回报，我们认为应该将资源投入到更大的机遇中。目前，主机和PC仍然是我们旗下最大IP的核心发展方向。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201415542563.png
“手游在中长期仍然存在机会，例如《刺客信条：侠隐》。但我们的重点是真正确保主机和PC业务实现强劲增长，尤其是PC平台，它如今比以往任何时候都更加充满活力。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201415596251.jpg
值得一提的是，《刺客信条：侠隐》并非唯一一款以中国为背景的《刺客信条》新游，此前有爆料称，曾有过一款腾讯天美工作室群主导开发的正统《刺客信条》新作，故事时间线上比《刺客信条：侠隐》稍晚，但已被取消。

为了逃离企图将怪物赶尽杀绝的传说级勇者，你将与怪物们一起穿越不同维度，在奇幻、武侠、末世、赛博朋克等风格各异的世界中，迎战当地的冒险者。

https://image.gcores.com/423f402b54af75baf1c6957df2c4f70f-1268-712.png
《满盘怪招》计划于 2027 年第一季度推出，支持简体中文。

news.title: 涂黑脸=种族歧视？日本Coser还原《宝可梦》黑皮角色被冲
news.summary: 日本Coser还原黑皮肤宝可梦角色，结果被海外网友指责种族歧视：只是还原角色，还是“黑脸”？

content.v: 受历史因素影响，“种族歧视”在欧美地区向来是颗隐形炸弹——你永远不知道它埋在哪，也不知道谁会踩上去。
有时候，只是简简单单的一句话、一个手势，就能把这颗炸弹引爆。
往往当事人还没来得及开口辩解，“种族歧视”的帽子就已经被扣下。随之而来的，还有那铺天盖地的舆论。
而最近，就有Coser因为还原了游戏角色的皮肤，在海外社交平台上，引发了一场关于种族歧视的争论。
事情是这样的：
就在前两天，日本一名北海道的Coser「あぶー」（@tera_abu）在X平台上传了一张自己和朋友Cos《宝可梦传说Z-A》里“由紫”和随从“春紫”的双人合照。
如果有玩过游戏，或者是看过相关宣传的朋友就知道，由紫的设定是一个深皮肤、浅紫色头发的“优雅大小姐”。
而tera_abu为了尽可能还原这个角色，不仅在服装和假发上下足了功夫，甚至就连自己的脸和身体都特意用深色粉底液给涂黑了。
说实话，Coser为了还原角色，选择用其他颜色相近的粉底液或者颜料来改变肤色，这是一件再正常不过的事情。
曾经就有人为了在漫展上Cos龟派气功，把全身都涂成了蓝色;还有人为了Cos章鱼哥把脸涂成了绿色……
这些大家都已经见怪不怪了。
但偏偏，tera_abu这次Cos的，是一个黑皮角色。
正如上文所说，种族问题向来是欧美地区的一个隐形炸弹。而tera_abu涂黑肤色行为，无疑是触发到了一些人的敏感肌。
于是，一大批人冲到tera_abu的评论区底下，指责她在搞“blackface”，并且还扣上了种族歧视的帽子。
给一些不了解的朋友简单介绍一下：
Blackface起源于19世纪的美国“吟游滑稽表演”。
当时的白人喜剧演员为了取悦观众，会用煤油、鞋油或者是其他的深色颜料把脸涂黑，然后用一种夸张的表演方式去刻意模仿、丑化黑人形象。
久而久之，Blackface就在欧美地区演变成了一种“种族歧视”的符号。
不可否认的是，这种表演形式带来的历史伤害是真实存在的。
要是有人刻意玩“Blackface”的话，别说被骂了，就算被扔臭鸡蛋、烂菜叶那也是咎由自取，没什么值得同情的。
但问题是，咱们前面也说过，“由紫”这个角色本身就是一个黑皮设定，tera_abu涂黑只是为了还原角色，而不是为了还原歧视。
并且，她也没有做出任何故意丑化黑人的行为，或者是一些含有侮辱性的 动作 。
如果脱离语境，仅凭一张Cos的照片，就把tera_abu和种族歧视联系在一起的话，多少有点牵强了。
因此，外网上也有不少人站出来，为处在风暴中心的tera_abu辩论。
有网友调侃，如果涂黑皮肤算歧视，那欧美Cos为了还原皮卡丘把自己的肤色涂黄，是不是也是一种种族歧视呢?
也有人拿《龙珠》举例，表示如果按照这个逻辑，那绿皮肤的比克，会不会被青蛙起诉呢?
还有人联想到了90年代末在东京涩谷非常流行的街头亚文化穿搭——黑辣妹装，而这种妆容追求的就是黝黑的皮肤和张扬的妆容。
由此可见，对于“美黑”这件事，日本显然有着属于自己的文化背景。
但是，这些解释在抨击者面前，就像是一根针掉进了大海，连个响都没能溅起来。
因为在他们看来，不管Coser的初衷是什么、不管有没有恶意，只要把皮肤涂黑，就触碰了历史伤疤。
眼看舆论愈演愈烈，tera_abu也终于忍不住站出来回应了。
她表示自己知道“由紫”是一个比较容易引起争议的角色，但却没想到这种情况竟然真的会降临在自己头上。
因为《宝可梦》的角色并没有明确设定人种，所以在她看来，角色的肤色就跟眼睛颜色一样，都只是设计的一部分。面对外界的争议，她也会选择不再理会。
为了避免事态进一步恶化，tera_abu在表完态后，就把账号设置成了非公开状态。
事实上，这已经不是Cos圈第一次因为“还原角色肤色”被骂种族歧视了。
就在前不久，《BanG Dream！》“纯田真奈”的声优反田叶月也因为晒出的万圣节造型，同样被扣上了种族歧视的帽子。
众所周知，每年万圣节的时候，街头总会充斥着各路牛鬼蛇神。
而今年万圣节的时候，《小羊肖恩》第三季刚好也才在日本刚上映没多久。
于是，反田叶月就灵机一动，Cos起了小羊肖恩。
然后，反田叶月就化身成了“南孚电池”——一节更比一节强。
照片里的她，不仅把整张脸都涂黑了，还披了张用棉花做的“羊皮”。除此以外，她的手里还拿着香蕉和大葱作为道具。
正如上文所说，Blackface在欧美地区是一种种族歧视符号，而棉花这玩意在历史上也与黑人有着莫大的渊源。
更别提她的手里还拿着容易让人联想到黑人经常被骂是猩猩或猴子的香蕉。
这三样东西单独拎出来都够呛，叠在一起那更是威力无穷。
很快，一些应激的欧美网友就冲到这篇帖子下面，以种族歧视为由，并对她进行各种攻击。
与此同时，也有大量网友站出来为反田叶月辩护，认为小羊肖恩本身就是黑脸绵羊，涂黑脸只是为了还原角色。
如果仅凭这一点，就要指责反田是在搞种族歧视的话，那不如先把《小羊肖恩》的原作者给冲了——谁让他把小羊的脸给画黑了呢?
至于反田叶月为什么会拿香蕉?

news.title: 记得手动存档！GTA6主播11小时进度丢失 直接哭了

content.v: IGN 报道，YouTube 拥有 130 万粉丝的主播 JasonTheWeen 在《GTA6》发售当天进行马拉松直播，打到第二章时误按关机键关掉了 PS5，11 个小时的进度和整个章节一起没了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201324356395.png
反应过来之后他直接在直播里哭了。“我不做了，” 他哽咽着说，“天哪，11 个小时！” 随后他打电话给频道编辑或经纪，问能不能联系到 R 星，“有没有办法让我回到第二章？我不知道你们能做什么，我不知道该怎么办”。对方让他把手上所有信息整理好发过来，由他们去联系 R 星试试 。
按 IGN 的分析，《GTA6》在每个任务结束时自动存档，他大概率是在存档写入过程中关机，把存档写坏了。所以最稳妥的做法还是手动存档，并且分开几个存档位轮着存，不要只依赖自动存档。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201324443985.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201324465877.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201324473445.png
更糟的还在后面。刚丢了进度，他就被报了假警（swatting）。他在镜头前说 “不可能，这绝对不可能”，紧接着屋外传来喊声，他说 “警察在外面，让我出去”，然后离开画面去和警方交涉 。
这场事故还有个前因：直播早些时候，他不小心把 PS5 的登录二维码露在了画面里，等于把账号大门敞开给可能的黑客。之后他在 X 上发文求助：“我不小心关了 PS5，丢了 11 个多小时的进度，有没有办法恢复？” 到目前为止没有回应 。

news.title: R星称GTA6其实还是没做完！开发时间和人手都不够
news.summary: 随着《GTA6》终于在全球正式发售，这款开放世界游戏的首批评价也陆续出炉。评论家们对Rockstar的新作赞不绝口，不少人称其为一款足…

content.v: 随着《GTA6》终于在全球正式发售，这款开放世界游戏的首批评价也陆续出炉。评论家们对Rockstar的新作赞不绝口，不少人称其为一款足以定义未来数年游戏行业的世代级作品，而玩家也对罪恶城令人惊叹的细节表现感到震撼。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201148586377.jpg
不过，玩家也发现了《GTA6》存在的一些不足，这并不令人意外。如今，Rockstar出面解释了为什么这款备受期待的作品缺少一些功能。
据Tech4Gamers报道，在接受采访时，Rockstar North工作室负责人Rob Nelson表示，有些内容之所以没有出现在《GTA6》中，是因为工作室没有足够的时间将其打磨到理想水平。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201149037496.jpg
这位Rockstar联合负责人解释称，即便是全球规模最大的游戏工作室之一，也不可能拥有无限的时间和资金，将游戏中的每一个细节都做到尽善尽美。
他表示：“即便是我们……你们可能听说过，有些工作室拥有无限的资金或无限的时间，但即便是我们也没有。所以有时候，你只能承认，我们没办法把某项内容做到自己认为应该达到的水平。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201149095011.jpg
因此，对于飞镖、保龄球等小游戏，Rockstar也不得不接受现实：他们没有足够的资源来实现开发团队真正想要达到的效果。
尽管如此，Tech4Gamers指出，凭借约3.3万名NPC，以及堪称游戏史上最接近真实城市的开放世界表现，《GTA6》目前仍然证明了自己长达十年的开发周期和高昂预算并非徒劳。

news.summary: 你可能已经听说，玩家能够在《GTA6》中从“51区”救出一名外星人，但在此之前，需要先完成全部三次外星人遭遇事件，包括其中的解谜…

content.v: 你可能已经听说，玩家能够在《GTA6》中从“51区”救出一名外星人，但在此之前，需要先完成全部三次外星人遭遇事件，包括其中的解谜环节。外媒The Gamer撰写了一篇攻略指南，详细讲述了该任务链的触发条件和完成方法。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201122073658.png
外星人遭遇事件1——UFO绑架
首先，玩家需要经历一次外星人绑架事件。前往盖尔霍恩港东部区域即可触发，该地点距离第二章中汽车旅馆以西不远，开车很快就能抵达。
凌晨2点左右，玩家可以在那里发现一辆废弃汽车。沿着汽车所在的道路继续前进，就能发现一架UFO。你可以与外星人留下的一名女性互动，随后返回取走她的汽车，便会遭到外星人绑架。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201134159701.png
只有完成这次遭遇事件，玩家才能获得进入51区所需的密码。
外星人遭遇事件2——奇怪的梦境
遭到绑架后，玩家需要完成几项活动，然后上床睡觉。醒来时有一定概率进入一个纯白色房间。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201134337057.png
转身寻找一扇黑色大门，进入后会来到一个摆满蛋的房间。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201134462358.png
在这个房间里，玩家需要保持蹲伏状态，并尽量贴着左侧前进。你必须悄悄穿过这些蛋，同时避免靠得太近。如果引爆的蛋太多，就会有一条触手抓住你，迫使你重新挑战。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201134584785.png
抵达发光区域后，玩家会进入一个摆放着太阳系各个行星的房间。与中央的球体互动，然后穿过房门来到一个密码键盘前。
密码的提示就在你的头顶，只需要数清楚上面的线条，就能得出正确的数字顺序，涉及数字1、2、3和4。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201135067723.png
接下来的房间里有一个需要互动的控制面板。玩家必须将所有灯光变成蓝色。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201135235780.png
完成后，前方会出现三个房间。注意，不要进入中间的房间，因为那里是致命陷阱。
首先进入左侧房间，拿起里面的牛奶瓶。随后前往右侧房间，将牛奶瓶放入指定位置，即可让角色醒来。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201135408894.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201135416597.png
外星人遭遇事件3——神秘地点与营救任务
梦境中出现的神秘地点位于哈姆雷特以南，具体位置如下。玩家需要驾驶汽车前往，并直接撞开入口处的大门。
进入后向右走，可以找到一扇双开门，玩家需要将其撞开。随后沿楼梯向下，就能看到一个密码键盘。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201136125789.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201136146013.png
这里的51区密码与梦境中的密码完全相同。如果没有先完成梦境事件，就无法进入51区。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201136254684.png
继续穿过里面的房间，玩家会找到另一个控制面板，按照之前的顺序依次按下按钮即可。
完成后，玩家可以进入左侧房间拿取牛奶瓶，再将其放入右侧房间的机器中。与梦境中的情况一样，中间的房间会导致角色死亡，千万不要进入。
放入牛奶瓶后，玩家就可以从容器中取出外星人。不过需要注意，这一操作会触发毒气释放，因此必须立即跑向电梯逃离现场！
成功离开后，外星人会在为玩家提供永久性的生命值、体力和专注力加成后，返回自己的飞船。
成功救出外星人后，它会乘坐飞船离开，而玩家很快就会被一群士兵包围。不过，UFO随后会再次返回，并使用武器消灭这些士兵。
最后，UFO会通过摩斯电码向玩家发送“谢谢”，随后彻底离开。不过，完成任务后并不会获得任何科幻武器。

news.title: 罗永浩被指拿刘欢女儿讲段子 网友喊话道歉 本人回应

content.v: 快科技11月20日消息，近日，知名主持人水均益转发了刘欢妻子卢璐写的公开信《他是这样的人》。
在这封约8000字的长信中，卢璐专门澄清了一件困扰家人多年的事：女儿曾用名“刘一丝”，取自刘欢大学时用过的外语名Lewis的谐音。
多年前，一段课堂音频把这个名字与“一丝不挂”联系起来。如今旧音频再次流传，她决定把取名和改名的经过说清楚。
据卢璐回忆，女儿还没出生时，刘欢就想好了“一丝”这个名字。除了读音和Lewis相近，他还觉得这两个字好写、好读，也不容易重名。
后来有记者把这个名字解读为夫妻俩“千里姻缘一线牵”，卢璐说，那是记者赋予它的一层浪漫意味。
女儿改名，则源于一件发生在学校里的小事。大约在小学三年级时，英语老师告诉夫妻俩，女儿个子娇小，同学们常喊她“一丝儿”，便建议家长考虑改名。
刘欢起初没太在意，卢璐却担心孩子总被这样打趣，时间久了会有心理压力。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201130324636.png
于是她说服丈夫，两人一起去了派出所，把女儿的名字改成“刘熠思”。夫妻俩保留了当初喜欢的读音，换了两个字义更明确的字。
信中提到的课堂音频，又是怎么回事？卢璐回忆，大约二十一二年前，土豆网上流传过一段课堂录音。
一名老师在新东方的课堂上拿“刘一丝”讲段子，声称刘欢是从“一丝不挂”中给女儿取的名，引得台下学生哄笑。
卢璐第一次听到录音时很气愤，更担心年幼的女儿听到后难堪，于是找了律师，打算通过起诉制止传播。
据卢璐介绍，律师联系了土豆网法务，平台了解情况后很快下架了音频。律师也提醒她，一旦起诉，这段原本已经下架的录音可能引来更多关注。夫妻俩权衡后，没有继续起诉。
直到最近，这段旧音频换了形式再次传播，卢璐才在信中重提此事，明确表示女儿的曾用名与那个段子“完全无关”。
卢璐在信中没有点名授课者。 公开信引发讨论后，部分网友根据录音中的声音猜测当事人是罗永浩，并喊话要求他道歉。
面对网友留言，罗永浩回应称：“你们这帮××怎么还没完没了了呢？一会儿我发辟谣帖。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201130438282.png
不过，截至本文发稿前，罗永浩尚未发布他此前提到的辟谣帖。
除了澄清围绕家人的传言，卢璐也在信中交代了刘欢的患病经过。据她回忆，刘欢于2012年确诊膀胱癌，接受治疗五年后复发。
患病期间，他仍曾参加音乐综艺录制。后来癌细胞扩散，在北京接受两轮治疗后效果不佳，夫妻俩转赴上海求医。
今年9月，刘欢在上海治疗期间突发腹泻，随后病情急转直下，于中秋节因感染性休克去世。

news.title: 印度获评2027年度最佳旅游目的地 街景实拍引发争议
news.summary: 近日，美国高端旅游杂志《Travel + Leisure》将印度评选为2027年度最佳旅游目的地，这项年度评选由编辑部综合甄选，此前巴西、泰国…

content.v: 近日，美国高端旅游杂志《Travel + Leisure》将印度评选为2027年度最佳旅游目的地，这项年度评选由编辑部综合甄选，此前巴西、泰国、哥斯达黎加都曾拿下该称号。
杂志盛赞印度拥有丰富多元的人文与自然景观，从千年神庙、古城遗址，到山地风光、海岸与康养资源，独特的地域文化、美食和民俗体验，构成极具吸引力的旅行价值。
消息一经发布，立刻在全网引发热议，坐拥1150万粉丝的印度马恒达集团（Mahindra Group）董事长、印度顶级工业巨头“anand mahindra”发布推文表达自己的希冀。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201123315806.jpg
不过并非所有网友都想印度人那般认可这样的结果，随即有博主发起街景挑战，打开地图街景随机选取印度城市街区，360度展示街头真实环境。
结果不出所料，随机点进去，就能看到道路边上随处堆放的垃圾，和杂志宣传里精致的旅游宣传片画面形成强烈反差。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201123315716.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201123318413.jpg
还有实地探访的旅行博主放出实拍视频，记录下德里、瓦拉纳西等区域的街头景象，曝光景区周边宰客、卫生条件堪忧等现实问题，进而提出疑问：评选只聚焦高端度假村与知名景点，是否忽略普通游客会直面的城市基础设施短板。
此外在评论区也是炮火连天，来自世界多个国家的网友纷纷表达自己的不同观点，有人直抒胸臆、有人指东打西，还有人一语中的：“你居然得跑到人类无法建立文明的地方，才能在印度找到美。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201123318787.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201123321918.jpg

news.title: 《GTA6》HDR最佳画面设置！沉浸式体验更上一层楼
news.summary: Twisted Voxel今日发布了一篇指南文章，旨在帮助玩家调整画面设置，以便获得最佳的HDR画面表现。当然，具体体验可能因人而异，但玩…

content.v: Twisted Voxel今日发布了一篇指南文章，旨在帮助玩家调整画面设置，以便获得最佳的HDR画面表现。当然，具体体验可能因人而异，但玩家不妨先尝试这一设置，若感觉效果不佳再自行调节。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201109189664.jpg
据了解，游戏的HDR校准选项并不直观，想要获得最佳画面效果，玩家需要了解每个滑块对画面的具体影响。
首先，游戏实际输出的峰值亮度会略低于玩家设置的数值。在默认纸白亮度为50的情况下，最大亮度设置为1000时，实际输出约为960尼特；设置为2000时，实际输出则约为1960尼特。
降低纸白亮度会让整个画面变暗，包括阴影区域，同时也会降低峰值亮度。纸白亮度每降低5点，整体亮度就会下降约17%。对于大多数玩家来说，将其设置在40至50之间会比较舒适，尤其是在光线较暗的房间中。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201109278627.jpg
黑位设置决定了画面的黑色基准以及阴影细节的可见程度。默认数值50会明显抬高黑位，导致暗部场景看起来比预期更加明亮。对于在暗室中游玩的OLED显示器用户，建议将黑位设置为15，以获得近乎完美的黑色表现。如果希望保留更多阴影细节，也可以选择30，同时维持不错的黑位效果。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201109335153.jpg
根据上述分析， 以下是获得理想HDR画面效果的推荐设置：
最大亮度： 根据显示设备实际峰值亮度进行设置。建议通过2%至3%的小窗口测试显示器的真实峰值亮度。
纸白亮度： 调整至40至50之间，以获得自然舒适的整体画面效果。设置为50时，HDR峰值亮度的实际输出最接近滑块所设定的数值。由于降低纸白亮度也会降低峰值亮度，因此可以适当提高最大亮度进行补偿。不过需要注意，这样也会抬高画面的中间调亮度，让整体画面变得更亮。
黑位： 在暗室中使用OLED显示器时建议设置为15；如果希望看到更多阴影细节，可以设置为30。

news.title: IGN：《GTA6》高人气美女很恐怖！杰森躲过一劫
news.summary: 《GTA6》早期登场NPC曼迪在网络迅速走红，除了对主角杰森表现出强烈迷恋之外，不少玩家在任务结束后探索周边环境，发掘出一系列令人…

content.v: 【剧透提示】本文涉及《GTA6》前期任务剧情内容，介意的玩家可以谨慎阅读。
《GTA6》早期登场NPC曼迪在网络迅速走红，除了对主角杰森表现出强烈迷恋之外，不少玩家在任务结束后探索周边环境，发掘出一系列令人细思极恐的线索，IGN也整理了相关发现进行报道。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201104516392.png
在开篇收租任务当中，曼迪故意谎称水槽故障，以此骗杰森上门，还换上比基尼试图引诱对方，但遭到杰森拒绝。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201105107858.jpg
杰森疏通管道时掏出一截断指，曼迪立刻抢下物件慌忙跑开。如果玩家任务结束后不立刻离开，继续在房屋周边探索，会看到后院有一处新挖掘、大小酷似埋尸坑的土坑，旁边摆放着强酸桶；打开她的汽车后备箱，同样能看到强酸以及疑似用于绑架行凶的工具。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201105188568.jpg
IGN表示，目前没有实锤能够坐实曼迪就是连环杀手，按照定义连环杀手需要至少三名受害者，但种种痕迹表明她至少犯下过一起命案。

news.title: 《终焉车站 暮色版》确认登陆NS，实体版现已开放预订
news.summary: 独立游戏发行商“PLAYISM”宣布，个人游戏开发者viv开发的2D探索型恐怖冒险游戏《终焉车站 暮色版》Nintendo Switch版将于2027年3月25日发售。并且，本作的实体版现已开放预订。 此外，本作也确定将

content.v: 独立游戏发行商“PLAYISM”宣布，个人游戏开发者viv开发的2D探索型恐怖冒险游戏《终焉车站 暮色版》Nintendo Switch版将于2027年3月25日发售。并且，本作的实体版现已开放预订。
此外，本作也确定将在11月21日，于中国上海举办的“WePlay Expo 2026”上提供试玩。
https://image.gcores.com/fb0c91c9e877967dd7604d3a1fc5c0ec-1920-1080.png
自2025年3月发布以来，本作作为个人开发免费游戏，创下累计160万下载量这一罕见佳绩、持续获得国内外玩家热烈支持。而如今，本作终于确定登陆Nintendo Switch。
在《终焉车站 暮色版》中，玩家可以一次性畅玩游戏本体、DLC《黄昏电鉄》以及两款迷你游戏。
故事简介
“在末班车睡过头之后，醒来时发现自己身处名为‘终焉车站’的神秘之地……”做什么都不顺利、缺乏自信又自卑的上班族——春夏冬 春。
某天，他在末班电车上睡过了站，醒来后发现自己被困在一个名为“终焉车站”的诡异地方。这里不断发生着惨烈而离奇的超自然现象。而与主人公性格截然相反、开朗优秀的同事，同时也是他曾经的好友——立浪紫苑，竟也阴差阳错地被困在了这里。两人约定携手合作，一同寻找逃出生天的方法。
由于已经有一段时间没有联系，起初两人的相处显得有些生疏。但随着他们一次次克服困境，也逐渐找回了昔日的默契，彼此之间的羁绊更是愈发深厚。然而，隐藏在这一切背后的世界真相，也开始逐渐浮出水面……
游戏本篇采用四种多重结局的故事结构。根据玩家的行动，“依存度”会随之发生变化，并由此决定最终迎来的结局。
角色介绍
⚫︎春夏冬 春
上班族，对自己很没有自信，很不擅长和人来往。笨拙，经常被上司责骂。
由于比立浪早两个月入职，被要求表现得像前辈。和立浪是同龄，私底下关系不错。然而，随着立浪愈发出类拔萃，春夏冬的自卑和嫉妒驱使着他开始主动和立浪保持距离。
⚫︎立浪 紫苑
与春夏冬在同一家公司、同一部门工作。尊称春夏冬为“前辈”，对他常用敬语。不过，在其优秀、温柔、开朗的外在表现下，潜藏着的是……
https://image.gcores.com/766d438a17ee37080ce34dea78310c3b-769-433.png
https://image.gcores.com/bcdb819cbe6ba37c6294f4ec1bdae8e1-769-433.png
https://image.gcores.com/e328c5a01c1449e54cabb058c0075251-769-433.png
https://image.gcores.com/8cf2116c21c6f43834fae391416680b9-769-433.png
https://image.gcores.com/b29cb43975fe4b78a1e9e1b8a33ed7e9-769-433.png
https://image.gcores.com/e2376ae79806430491450d5cd4049087-793-433.jpeg
实体版现已开放预订
自今日（11月20日）起，各渠道将陆续开启实体版预约。首批预购特典将附赠以电车和游戏角色为主题的“摇摇亚克力立牌钥匙扣”。此外，本作还将推出限定版，在特制包装盒内附赠“全新绘制的迷你游戏书”及“春紫苑手帕”。特典及限定版数量有限，有兴趣的玩家还请尽早预订。
https://image.gcores.com/3c6b8abc6d6d0a0a3970f9881714ce54-1754-1075.jpeg
确定参展“WePlay Expo 2026”提供试玩
WePlay Expo 2026将于11月21日至22日，在中国上海举办。在PLAYISM B48展位上，Nintendo Switch版的《终焉车站 暮色版》将首次出展。
凡参与试玩的玩家，都将获赠特制“亚克力雨伞挂扣”！
https://image.gcores.com/b19a193123eee8d1ec1a9eaf64c6ce43-223-433.png
此外，现场C34-4还将设置还原《终焉车站》系列名场面的展位，出售《终焉车站 暮色版》周边商品，并举办开发者viv的签名会。计划到场的玩家欢迎莅临。

贾国龙再换赛道测试新店型 西贝10个月已关店176家
news.summary: 近日，西贝创始人贾国龙再次尝试新业态，在此前推出的“天边砂锅焖面”门店暂停营业后，贾国龙将原有铺面改为“天边冰煮鲜羊”。

content.v: 近日，西贝创始人贾国龙再次尝试新业态，在此前推出的“天边砂锅焖面”门店暂停营业后，贾国龙将原有铺面改为“天边冰煮鲜羊”。
11月19日，天边冰煮鲜羊呼和浩特首店正式开业，这也是“天边”系列首家以冰煮鲜羊命名的独立门店。据悉，新店主打鲜羊料理，羊肉来自自有牧场，并延续了每日标注羊肉到店时间的做法，蔬菜则强调现摘现煮。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201049004165.jpg
值得注意的是，这家新店并非全新选址，而是此前天边砂锅焖面呼和浩特首店的原址。该焖面门店今年3月开业，经营约半年后于9月15日暂停营业，如今换上新招牌，继续探索餐饮新模式。
今年以来，贾国龙围绕“天边”系列不断尝试，从砂锅焖面到鲜羊料理，持续调整产品和门店定位。与此同时，西贝主品牌也在增加鲜羊相关菜品，尝试寻找新的增长点。
但新业态探索的另一面，是西贝主品牌门店持续收缩。据公开信息，截至11月11日，西贝全国门店数量为173家，而今年1月这一数字为349家，10个月减少176家，门店规模缩水超过一半。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201049164119.jpg
资本层面的压力同样受到关注，国家企业信用信息公示系统显示，11月初，贾国龙将其直接持有的西贝25.59%股权全部质押，涉及出质股权数额约2660.40万元。此前9月2日，其妻子张丽平也将直接持有的5.19%股权全部质押，涉及出质股权数额540万元。
业内人士认为，贾国龙目前正通过主品牌收缩和新品牌试错寻找出路，但在门店持续减少、融资空间受到关注的情况下，新业态能否尽快形成稳定盈利模式，将成为关键。
从砂锅焖面到冰煮鲜羊，贾国龙仍在寻找新的增长突破口。不过新店开业只是第一步，能否实现持续盈利、形成可复制的经营模式，才是真正的考验。

content.v: 11月20日零点，邓紫棋全新专辑第二主打《任天堂》在未作任何预热的情况下突然上线各大音乐平台。她本人在社交平台发文解释了这次“突袭”的用意：“如果人生是一场游戏，那就各种剧情体验一场——比如写小说，比如新曲风，比如新歌搞突袭！”

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201041402773.png

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201044411252.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201044427902.png
《任天堂》由邓紫棋包办词曲，并与宫阁共同完成制作与编曲。她在发文中引用了核心歌词“我活在我的任天堂/人生不过游戏一场”，并阐述了歌曲的态度：“无论放眼世界，还是聚焦生活，事与愿违的事情总不少见。但改变不了环境，就改变自己的心境。”她特别标注了一句“没有合作，就想玩！”，明确这首歌并非与任天堂的官方联动，而是借用游戏语汇表达一种心境自由的人生态度。作为新专辑第二主打，它延续了邓紫棋在曲风上的探索。

news.title: GS确认《GTA6》多结局！最佳结局达成条件曝光
news.summary: 《GTA》一直以其开放和丰富的互动而著称，考虑到无论是4代还是5代，都要求玩家在关键节点做出选择以达成不同的结局，外界普遍认为《…

content.v: 《GTA》一直以其开放和丰富的互动而著称，考虑到无论是4代还是5代，都要求玩家在关键节点做出选择以达成不同的结局，外界普遍认为《GTA6》也会遵循类似的设计，GameSpot也在今日发布了一篇攻略文章，确认多结局存在的同时也简单介绍了达成不同结局的判定条件。
请注意，本文会尽可能避免透露具体剧情细节。但如果您认为即便是结局数量、后期系统介绍也属于剧透，请谨慎阅读或考虑退出这篇文章。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201040496728.jpg
GameSpot在文中指出，他们已完整通关游戏，并得到了Rockstar官方确认，可以确定《GTA6》确实拥有多个结局。但目前尚不清楚玩家最终能够触发的结局总数究竟有多少。
不过，根据评测者以及其他已经通关的玩家反馈，目前至少存在4种结局。随着更多玩家以不同方式体验游戏，这一数字未来可能还会增加，但截至目前，已经确认的结局至少有4种。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201040596390.jpg
游戏后期至少有两套系统会影响剧情走向：露西娅与杰森共同账户中的资金数量，以及两人之间的亲密关系程度。
想要达成最佳结局，需要让两人深爱彼此，同时将共同储蓄账户的余额提升至最高额度——200万美元。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201041269214.jpg
如果两人的关系达到最高等级，但银行账户没有存满，则可以达成一个不错、但并非最佳的结局。
部分玩家还猜测，杰森与露西亚的犯罪侧写也可能影响最终结局。玩家可以在地图菜单中的关系选项卡查看两人的犯罪侧写，而这些内容会根据玩家在《GTA6》中的行为发生变化。例如，在剧情中选择放过某个角色，而不是将其射杀，就会影响主角的犯罪档案。游戏中存在“冷酷”和“疯狂”等不同档案名称，但目前尚不清楚最终犯罪档案会对结局产生怎样的影响。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201041453617.jpg
此外，玩家在剧情中做出的某些选择也可能最终影响结局。Rockstar明确表示，游戏中的任务存在多种完成方式，因此某些任务的不同处理方式或许也会对最终结局产生影响。

news.title: 新突破！科学家造出无电池神经接口 成功逆转糖尿病
news.summary: 11月20日消息，新加坡国立大学团队联合南京邮电大学团队的最新研究成果，正式登上了顶级学术期刊《自然》，给全球糖尿病治疗领域带…

content.v: 11月20日消息，新加坡国立大学团队联合南京邮电大学团队的最新研究成果，正式登上了顶级学术期刊《自然》，给全球糖尿病治疗领域带来了突破性的全新方案。
两个团队联合打造出一款名为NeuroAxis的人工神经免疫轴装置，在大鼠动物实验模型中，完全依靠血糖供能，全程自主运行闭环调控，成功逆转了实验大鼠的二型糖尿病症状，这在全球相关研究领域尚属首次实现。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201029221166.jpg
临床上的二型糖尿病，往往和肥胖、胰岛素抵抗、身体长期慢性炎症高度绑定，传统治疗方案很难从根源上唤醒人体自身的血糖调节机制，而这次研发出的NeuroAxis装置，在二型糖尿病大鼠模型的对照实验中展现出了远超预期的优异疗效。
研究团队设置的多组对照试验数据显示，仅接受这款装置治疗两周时间，原本患病大鼠的血糖水平就降到了几乎和健康大鼠持平的区间，对应的胰岛素抵抗指数也得到了显著降低，意味着大鼠身体对胰岛素的敏感度已经得到了有效恢复。
对于全球数以亿计的糖尿病患者来说，每天反复扎手指测血糖、定点按要求注射胰岛素，几乎成了日常生活里无法逃避的痛苦循环。当前绝大多数主流治疗手段都属于外部强制干预，很难唤醒人体自身原本的血糖调节能力，患者需要常年维持高负担的治疗流程。
如果后续这款技术能够顺利落地转化，最终形态只是一款体积很小的植入物，完全不需要额外搭载电池，直接就可以利用人体血液里的葡萄糖作为运行燃料，通过实时自动刺激对应神经的方式动态调整血糖水平，这对所有饱受糖尿病困扰的患者来说，无疑是改变人生的重大福音。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201029238537.jpg
这项由中外顶尖高校联合攻关取得的突破性成果，彻底跳出了传统糖尿病治疗长期靠外部给药干预的固化思路，通过融合生物电子、神经调控和能源自供给的交叉技术路径，给未来慢病的治愈方案开辟了一条完全不同的全新赛道，后续如果顺利推进人体临床落地，将直接改写全球数亿糖尿病患者的生存状态。

content.v: Digital Foundry发布的多平台技术分析指出，《GTA6》整体体验上，Xbox Series X在与基础版PS5的对比中，凭借系统级120Hz VRR获得了“稍微更平滑”的帧率感受。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201017167282.png
实测中，所有主机均以30fps为目标，PS5、PS5 Pro和Xbox Series X内部渲染分辨率均为1440p。PS5 Pro能持续维持30fps，仅在极端场景短暂跌至24fps；基础版PS5和Xbox Series X则经常在30fps与高20s之间波动，最坏可跌至20fps出头；Xbox Series S最弱，大量场景在25至30fps运行，车辆破坏场景可下探至20fps左右。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201017171658.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201017187982.png
Xbox Series X的流畅优势来自操作系统层面的120Hz VRR容器，可抹平帧率波动；而PS5的系统级VRR仅在帧率高于48fps时启动，且不支持低帧率补偿，对30fps游戏基本无效。

news.summary: 《GTA6》的存档机制可能让不少玩家吃亏。游戏虽然支持自动保存，但自动存档只有一个位置，新的自动存档会覆盖此前的记录。如果玩家…

content.v: 由你来说： 你觉得《GTA6》的存档机制设计的怎么样， 你有没有被这个存档机制坑到了？
《GTA6》的存档机制可能让不少玩家吃亏。游戏虽然支持自动保存，但自动存档只有一个位置，新的自动存档会覆盖此前的记录。如果玩家长时间没有手动保存，一旦意外退出游戏，就有可能损失大量进度。
据悉，游戏会在完成任务以及部分开放世界活动后触发自动存档。不过，这并不意味着玩家可以完全依赖自动保存。游戏还提供了15个手动存档位置，玩家可以通过暂停菜单进入“游戏（Game）”选项，再选择“保存游戏（Save Game）”进行手动存档。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201007551258.jpg
需要注意的是，序章期间以及执行任务时，玩家无法进行手动存档。因此，在自由探索、完成支线活动之后，最好养成随时保存的习惯。

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201008141205.jpg

content.v: 目前《GTA6》仅登陆主机平台，R星已经确认即便是PS5 Pro也不会提供60帧模式，硬件CPU性能不足以支撑更高帧率。IGN编辑在体验完PS5 Pro版本之后，分享了自己对未来PC移植版本的预期。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611200958283835.jpg
编辑表示，60fps仅仅是PC版的入门目标，但想要跑满帧率对不少现有PC配置依旧存在门槛。主机全部采用Zen2架构8核16线程处理器，而PC端大量玩家仍在使用老旧8核CPU，性能和主机差距不大；只有锐龙7000/9000系列、Intel 12代及更新的中端以上处理器，才有机会突破主机的帧率枷锁，本作性能瓶颈更多集中在CPU而非显卡。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611200958386318.jpg
在画面技术层面，编辑预计R星可以完整发挥DLSS的升采样与帧生成能力。作为节奏相对舒缓的开放世界单机，帧生成带来的延迟负面影响可以接受，目标甚至可以冲到240帧。这样游戏体验会更加流畅，也更能保护眼睛。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611200958467908.png
除帧率之外，他还期待PC版加入完整路径追踪效果，在PS5 Pro光追的基础上进一步逼近照片级画面。

news.title: 苹果iOS更新上线！iPhone Duo重大功能突破
news.summary: 快科技11月20日消息，苹果面向公测用户正式推送iOS 27.3公测版Beta 2，本次更新的一大亮点是为iPhone Duo首次引入2D人脸解锁功能，…

content.v: 快科技11月20日消息，苹果面向公测用户正式推送iOS 27.3公测版Beta 2，本次更新的一大亮点是为iPhone Duo首次引入2D人脸解锁功能，打破了苹果此前在iPhone上主要依赖3D Face ID和Touch ID进行生物识别解锁的惯例。
据了解，iPhone Duo新增“使用前置摄像头解锁”选项，用户可以直接通过外屏自拍摄像头识别人脸，无需每次都使用Touch ID或输入密码。不过，该功能仅在手机折叠状态下生效。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611200950014345.jpg
与苹果传统的Face ID不同，iPhone Duo采用的是2D人脸识别方案，这种方案的优势是硬件成本低、占用空间小，尤其适合内部结构紧凑的折叠屏手机，但安全性也存在明显局限。
由于缺少3D深度信息，2D人脸识别主要依靠算法判断面部特征，难以像3D结构光那样精确识别面部立体结构，对照片、视频等伪造攻击的抵御能力也更依赖算法水平。
因此，苹果对这项功能设置了严格限制。涉及支付、密码及App身份验证时，用户仍需使用Touch ID或密码；如果手机超过45分钟未解锁，再次解锁时也必须进行更高安全级别的身份验证。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611200950064400.jpg
对用户来说，2D人脸识别仍只是便利性功能，无法完全替代3D Face ID的安全认证能力。

content.v: 《GTA 6》玩家社区已经挖出了一个官方从未宣传的功能：第一人称模式。一名玩家发现的漏洞可以让游戏在特定操作下切换到第一人称视角，且“似乎可以正常使用”。
视频欣赏：
截图欣赏：
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611200936516977.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611200936514136.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611200936534331.png
根据该玩家分享的方法，操作路径如下：进入设置 → 控制器 → 触摸板按钮，将触摸板的映射功能改为“相机”；随后坐进驾驶座，按十字键上拿出手机；按圆圈/B收起手机，紧接着狂按触摸板按钮；重复几次后，视角便会切换为第一人称。该玩家提醒，目前没有正常的切换方式回到第三人称，必须重新加载存档才能恢复。

news.title: 《GTA6》爱爱系统详解：教你如何发生亲密关系
news.summary: 杰森与露西亚的关系是《GTA6》的核心内容之一，游戏中加入了多种恋爱机制与互动玩法。玩家可以带彼此约会、共同参与各种活动，当然…

content.v: 杰森与露西亚的关系是《GTA6》的核心内容之一，游戏中加入了多种恋爱机制与互动玩法。玩家可以带彼此约会、共同参与各种活动，当然，也可以进一步发展亲密关系。外媒Insider Gaming今日撰写了一篇攻略文章，详细介绍了《GTA6》的性爱与恋爱系统，包括如何触发杰森与露西亚的亲密互动，以及能否与其他角色发展关系。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611200923138298.jpg
想让杰森与露西亚在《GTA6》中发生性关系，玩家首先需要将两人的关系提升至第三或第四阶段。提升两人关系的操作并不复杂：多花时间陪伴彼此即可。带伴侣约会、参与各种活动，不断增进感情。投入的时间越多，两人的关系就会越亲密。
达到相应关系等级后，玩家便能解锁尺度更大的过场动画。具体场景会根据当前关系等级有所不同，第三阶段的互动相对有限，随后画面会淡出；而达到第四阶段后，则可以解锁更加露骨的场景。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611200923386563.jpg
此外，游戏剧情中也会出现两人主动亲密的情节，尤其是在完成某些任务后，他们可能会决定共度一夜。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611201102203132.jpg
不过，知道关系等级要求只是第一步，玩家究竟该如何主动触发这些互动？方法其实相当简单，而且有多种途径。玩家既可以在回家后与伴侣触发亲密互动，也可以在探索雷奥奈达州的途中触发相关选项——不过实际情况并没有听起来那么刺激。
与伴侣共同活动时，通常在约20分钟后，玩家聚焦伴侣时可能会出现“回家”的提示，同时地图上会出现带有小爱心标记的安全屋图标。选择该选项后，游戏会自动设置前往安全屋的路线，玩家与伴侣返回家中后即可触发后续过场动画。
如果已经身处家中，触发方式则更加多样。根据伴侣当前正在进行的活动，以及玩家所在的安全屋，与其互动时可能会出现不同的亲密互动选项。甚至只是选择与对方一起睡觉，也有可能触发浪漫场景。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611200924085414.png
需要注意的是，这些互动并不能无限次重复触发。对于想反复体验的玩家来说，恐怕要稍微耐心等待一下。通常需要经过数小时的现实时间，才能再次获得触发机会。不过，陪伴彼此以及触发这些互动，仍然能够持续提升杰森与露西亚的关系——这大概也是玩家们最期待的内容之一。
那么，《GTA6》可以与其他角色发生关系吗？答案是否定的，《GTA6》中的性互动仅限于杰森与露西亚之间。Rockstar将亲密互动设定为杰森与露西亚关系中的专属内容，让两人的感情成为游戏体验的核心。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/20/small_202611200924039976.jpg
不过，这并不意味着雷奥奈达州没有其他成人向娱乐活动。玩家可以操控杰森或露西亚前往各种脱衣舞俱乐部，甚至可以带伴侣一同前往。这些互动大多以舞蹈为主，但部分内容的尺度也相当大胆。
此外，《GTA6》也没有加入妓女相关内容，因此玩家无法重现系列前作中的部分经典玩法。如果想体验更亲密的互动，就只能专注于经营杰森与露西亚之间的关系了。

news.title: GTA 6 单人游戏的 GTA+ 就像基于订阅的马甲
news.summary: Would you pay $7.99 a month for one car and some in-game discounts?

content.v: If you preordered GTA 6 and head to the "store" page in the main menu, you'll see that you have a free month of GTA+, Rockstar's subscription service. If you didn't, you can subscribe for $7.99 a month.
Yep, weird as it sounds, there's a subscription option for a singleplayer game.

Subscribers to GTA+ for GTA Online get some decently sweet perks (and if you subscribe via GTA 6, you'll get them for GTAO too) like $500,000 of in-game cash every month, access to exclusive cars, multipliers on missions, discounts on in-game items, and more. But what does the GTA+ subscription get you in GTA 6?
Well, how does free rides on public transportation sound? Great, right? Can I sweeten the pot with 10% off haircuts? Huh? Huh? How about if your $10 scooter rental was comped . Are you in?

OK, you do also get a nice exclusive car and an extra garage to store it in. But there are already more than 500 vehicles in the game, so unless you're a diehard completionist, I don't think one more coupe is going to be missed, especially if you have to pay $7.99 to claim it.
And it's not like you're gonna show it off to anyone. This is a singleplayer game. Remember Bethesda's infamous horse armor DLC ? Imagine that, but you keep paying for it month after month.
Here's a full breakdown of what GTA+ will get you for GTA 6:

I have no doubt that when (if) GTA 6 gets an online component, GTA+ will be more substantial, but right now it's not the meatiest offering I've ever seen for a monthly bill on a singleplayer game, unless you want those GTA Online perks, too.

It's a cool looking car, and I can't dispute that those are definitely bonuses. But midway through the game you're not exactly going to be sweating rideshare costs or how much you're charged for new hairstyles. For now, at least, you might want to save your real money for something better.

news.title: GTA 6 可以第一人称视角玩，以下是激活方法
news.summary: I guess that's why the cars have speedometers.

content.v: While you can switch to first-person temporarily in Grand Theft Auto 6 when you want to get a real good close-up of a texture or when you're looking at your phone, you can't run around doing crimes and having fun like you could when GTA 5 got its first-person mode. Except actually you can, as discovered by players on Reddit and tested by our own Morgan Park.

It's easy enough to activate in-game. Go to the controller settings, then under the Controller Features section change your touch pad/select button to Camera 2 / 2. Get into a car, bring up your phone with the D-pad, press Circle or B then quickly hit Select. There you go, first-person GTA 6.

As Morgan's footage shows, it's completely playable. It doesn't look 100% done, however, with your shoulders clipping through the camera when you've got a longarm gun up. Seeing someone break into a car in first-person also looks a bit rough around the edges. While conspiracy theorists have convinced themselves that Rockstar is holding back this feature to sell it as DLC, I figure they're probably still polishing it to add in a future update.

If you want to leave first-person, you'll have to reload a save. It doesn't have to be an old save, though. If you save in first-person then immediately load the same save you'll be back in third-person and have to return to God's own preferred viewpoint.

news.title: 安卓模拟器Andarium现已登陆iOS及iPadOS
news.summary: 安卓虚拟机 Andarium 现已正式登陆苹果 App Store。作为货真价实的模拟器，Andarium 允许用户在 iPhone 和 iPad 上直接本地运行安卓系统，甚至可以自由安装 APK 文件。与其他的云端方案

content.v: 安卓虚拟机 Andarium 现已正式登陆苹果 App Store。作为货真价实的模拟器，Andarium 允许用户在 iPhone 和 iPad 上直接本地运行安卓系统，甚至可以自由安装 APK 文件。与其他的云端方案不同，Andarium 完全在设备本地运行。用户无需连接电脑进行繁琐调试，也无需注册账号，只需创建虚拟机即可启动。
https://image.gcores.com/14bbf1c6eca6bda87491180fe2ee7bc8-1350-759.jpg
据悉，应用支持直接从iOS系统的文件 App 中导入并安装APK安装包，并内置文件浏览器以实现跨系统文件传输。同时，Andarium 还采取免费下载、自愿打赏的模式。不仅没有广告，开发者的隐私声明中也表示不收集任何个人数据或遥测信息。
https://image.gcores.com/9de392b9760a598e6a50117ab082858d-600-810.jpg
配置要求方面， Andarium 需配备苹果A14或更新芯片的设备（iPhone 12及后续机型或搭载A14及M系列芯片的iPad），且系统版本须达到iOS 27或iPadOS 27及以上。首次配置时，官方建议设备预留至少10GB可用存储空间。受iOS后台机制约束，虚拟机仅在前台时运行，切换至其他软件便会自动暂停。
由于在 Andarium 是手机端通过虚拟化运行完整操作系统，卡顿、掉帧及机身发热现象而在所难免。当设备温度过高时，Andarium 也会主动弹窗提示并降低帧率以维持稳定。鉴于 App 包含不受限制的网络访问及侧载能力，不排除苹果会要求开发者修改 App 甚至直接采取下架措施。感兴趣的朋友可以尽快获取安装。

news.title: GTA 6 美国各地都有警察部门恳求人们不要在现实生活中犯罪
news.summary: GTA 6's popularity has led to police departments around the United States pleading with citizens to not commit

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/19/gta-6-jason-hoodie-1795130436791.jpg
GTA 6's popularity has led to police departments around the United States pleading with citizens to not commit real crimes.

GTA 6 is finally here, and you can carry out many of your wildest criminal fantasies. It's a very freeing experience, and Rockstar has added more depth than ever before to make crimes like simple robberies more intricate and nuanced. However, the usual suspects when it comes to a new GTA game (mainstream news outlets, like Fox News ) have expressed concern over what kind of impact this might have on society. Will it create real rampant crime or spikes in violence? Probably not, but police departments across the country have created PSAs to ask people not to commit crime.
The Atlanta Police Department put out a post asking people to express their more radical desires in-game and not in real life.

GTA is not a real place, but Atlanta is!🎮 Don't confuse virtual entertainment with real-life decisions. Drunk driving, reckless driving, auto theft and violence have real consequences. Keep it in the game. Don't bring it to our streets. https://t.co/Y7PdJFHLsZ
The police department in San Juan, Texas have asked players to keep their behavior in-game, noting that a six star wanted level in real life is not a challenge, but a criminal jail sentence.

It's a bit of fun to likely ride the GTA 6 hype wave. You'd be hard pressed to find a major company that isn't trying to capture GTA 6's excitement in some way right now, and it seems like even local governments are doing the same thing. As is always the case with GTA, there are some folks expressing concern over the game's contents. One concerned group in particular is the furry community , which is mocked in-game. Furries are illegal in GTA 6 and as a result, the police hunt them down and point weapons at them. It's pretty absurd, but some real furries don't find it very amusing.

This is all par for the course for this franchise, but it does seem like more non-gamers are trying to have fun with it since it's such a massive cultural event. As of right now, we don't know how well GTA 6 has sold, but it looks like it's going to have the biggest launch in entertainment history.

In their post, Cyberleek says they'll drop the one file they've withheld—the main executable—if their crypto coin reaches a $15 million market cap. Yeah, we're doing this again. Comments on a now-removed Reddit post say the leaked file is around 200 GB, which is close to the size of GTA 6 on consoles.
Cyberleek says they will release the exe on November 23, no matter what.

"It is an Xbox build this time, not a PC build. CL does not care. This community will have it emulated inside a week, running far past 30fps. CL told you not to preorder for a reason. This is one of the reasons," the posts read.

news.title: GTA 6 的病毒 NPC 实际上可能有一个黑暗的秘密
news.summary: A character in GTA 6 named Mandy has been going viral since the game's launch for being a total smokeshow, but

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/19/gta-6-mandy-1795125785845.jpg
Warning: Spoilers for GTA 6 ahead!
A character in GTA 6 named Mandy has been going viral for being a total smokeshow, but fans are also noticing that she seems to have a dark secret.

Early on in the game, Brian sends Jason to go retrieve rent from a tenant named Mandy, who refuses to pay until her sink is fixed. Once you get there, it's clear she has staged a maintenance emergency so Jason would turn up. She's madly obsessed with him, but Jason pays no mind, since he's still pursuing Lucia. She eventually tries to seduce Jason with a skimpy bikini, to no avail. He ends up pulling out whatever is lodged in her sink, which she quickly takes and runs off with.

Mandy eventually gets irritated with Jason's disinterest and kicks him out, but if players linger around the property, they may start to realize Mandy isn't just obsessive because she has a crush... but because she may be a killer. If you wander into her backyard, you will see a freshly covered-up, body-sized hole next to a few tubs of acid. But hey, maybe it's just a coincidence! If you pop the trunk of her car, you will also see more acid and tools someone might use to kidnap and kill a person. And if you take a quick look at what was in Mandy's sink, it appears to be a severed finger.

While it's unclear if she's actually a serial killer (it takes three victims to be classified as one, by the way), she does appear to have killed at least one person. It's unclear who the other guy is, but it's possible Jason could've met a similar fate. Does she seduce people in order to kill them? Or does she kill them because they reject her advances or hurt her emotionally? It's hard to say. Either way, it seems clear that there's definitely a screw loose, and it's good that Jason didn't fall for her seduction.

news.title: 今年 10 月视频游戏支出下降 14%，可能是因为每个人都在为《GTA 6》做准备
news.summary: The amount of money that players spent on video games this October fell 14%, and it’s little surprise that thi

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/18/gta-benefts-1794997452264.jpg
The amount of money that players spent on video games this October fell 14%, and it’s little surprise that this coincided with the release of GTA 6 in November.

A new report from market research firm Circana shows that gamers were a bit more frugal this October than they were last year, despite two major games releasing that month. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launched on October 23, and Gears of War: E-Day released on October 1. Both games enjoyed reasonable critical reception, though reviews for Modern Warfare 4 were rather mixed .

It’s worth noting that sales for E-Day paled in comparison to the rave reviews it received, with analysts estimating that the game only sold 400,000 copies across both console and PC as of October 30. And last October, Battlefield 6 rocked players’ wallets as one of the best-selling games in the entire series — and, indeed, the best-selling game of the entire year — so it’s not a head-scratcher that this was a tough act for MW4 and E-Day to follow.

Circana’s report found that consumer spending on console, specifically, fell 18% from last year, and compared this trend to sales from Battlefield 6 and Pokémon Legends: Z-A . The report pointed to a 16% decline in mobile spending as the primary driver of this drop in addition to Battlefield's booming sales from last October.

However, it’s hard to ignore the impact that GTA 6 has had on the industry at large. Earlier this month, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick revealed that the release of the world’s most highly anticipated game likely had an impact on the lower-than-expected sales for NBA 2K27, as well as other titles.

“I do think that this timing may have affected performance so far,” he told IGN in an exclusive interview . “It has been a crowded period, and we do think that GTA 6 coming has had an influence on the consumer. That said, we're thrilled with how NBA 2K27 is performing.”

The launch of GTA 6 has proven to be a massive and unprecedented moment in pop culture history, to the point where analysts saw a 17% increase in time off requests for its release date on November 19. Even world governments were hopping on the bandwagon, with Australia’s workplace regulator reminding employees of their rights to PTO in a viral post last month. Germany also boasts a program that allows workers to take time off for professional development to play the game.

If that wasn’t wild enough, a U.S. Army Battalion even advertised a special reenlistment incentive that gave service members four days of paid leave that directly coincided with GTA 6’s release, which 43 soldiers ended up taking . It remains to be seen if GTA 6 will really save the average gamer $5,000 by staying indoors, but so many people have hopped online to play that internet service providers reported a massive spike in traffic from Xbox consoles.

content.v: One of the first cool things that people discovered in Grand Theft Auto 6 is that if you swim out into the ocean too far, you'll find a dog riding a jetski who coaxes you back to shore.

As it turns out, the dog looks to be based on a real-life dog named Loosy who does neat stunts in Florida. In real life, Loosy is a golden retriever whose owner, Eddie Inch, gained viral fame when he rode a jet-propelled hoverboard in Fort Lauderdale as he towed a goggle-wearing Loosy behind him on a jetski.
It seems Rockstar took inspiration from this with GTA 6's own jetski-riding dog. However, GTA 6's dog is a different breed, but it still has goggles like Loosy.
Neither Loosy nor Inch are listed in GTA 6's credits , but it seems pretty obvious that this is a reference to the real-world viral dog.

GTA 6 launched today, November 19, for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The game is getting rave reviews , including a 10/10 from GameSpot . According to Sensor Tower, GTA 6 has sold more than 19 million copies and generated close to $2 billion already .

Doja Cat is extremely unhappy about getting passed over as a featured artist in GTA 6, and she’s making her feelings known in several blistering posts on social media.

GTA 6 , like other games in the series, features several different radio stations that players can scroll through as they zoom down the streets of Vice City. There’s oodles of licensed songs on these stations (we don’t even want to think about how costly this was for Rockstar to pull off), and PinkPantheress even hosts one as a DJ, which, of course, plays some of her music.
One artist who wasn’t included in the lineup was Doja Cat — who, as a gamer, was pretty pissed off about apparently getting snubbed by Rockstar for arguably the biggest game of the decade.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/19/screenshot-2026-11-19-113115-1795118917160.png

“I would’ve loved to have my music on GTA 6. I’m so f**kin’ bitter,” she wrote on Twitter/X on November 19. In another, she tagged the official Rockstar account, writing, “Eat my dick all yall, I love your stupid f**kin’ bitch-ass game.” She tagged them again in a third post, saying, “You broke my heart, pinche culero.”

As previously mentioned, Doja Cat is an avid gamer. She regularly streams on Twitch between recording new albums and touring, often choosing to play a few games of Fortnite while chatting with her audience. She’s even referenced the game in one of her songs (Agora Hills), and also included a cute line referencing the ‘We got xyz before GTA 6’ meme in her song ‘All Mine.’

Needless to say, Doja’s expletive-ridden tweets quickly went viral, attracting no end of discourse from both fans and critics about what artists got featured in the game and those who missed out. Others were quick to remind her that GTA 5 added new songs to its radio station later in the game’s lifetime, so there’s still a chance that she might get to be in the game at some point further down the line.
“They added newer songs on the radio later in GTA 5, so there’s still a chance sis,” one user commented .
“You’re actually a gamer, too, that’s why I feel bad,” another lamented .
“They added music over time to GTA 5. They might do it again. Start campaigning sis,” another encouraged .

GTA 6’s soundtrack features a slew of high-profile music artists, with the likes of Cardi B, Tame Impala, Travis Scott, and Keith Richards being just a few who contributed to the project. news.title: 魔兽世界：永远想要摆脱“BiS”装备的想法
news.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever is approaching itemization and "best-in-slot" (BiS) gear differently, with develope

content.v: World of Warcraft: Forever is approaching itemization and "best-in-slot" (BiS) gear differently, with developer Blizzard instead wanting players to have more boss- or biome-specific choices.
In the latest episode of the WoW: Forever Podcast , Blizzard dove deep on the MMORPG's itemization changes, how it approached designing Forever's new items, class changes, and more.
On the subject of raid gear and chase items, Forever senior game designer Aidan Moon said something that could be seen as controversial in certain circles of the game's community.
"I essentially want to get rid of BiS," Moon said. "I think that BiS is not a good thing for a video game that's supposed to be about [the] role-playing aspects of it."

BiS is WoW shorthand for essentially the best item that could possibly be in a given gear slot for a specific class. Look up any WoW guide for WoW Classic or modern WoW, and you'll find class BiS gear lists telling players exactly what they should be wearing in order for their character to be as powerful as possible. Endgame in many ways revolves around acquiring your BiS gear, first your "pre-raid" BiS from gear available in max-level dungeons, and then BiS gear, like tier sets, from raids.

It's for that exact reason Forever introduced new items that grant additional stats or effects against certain enemy types or even in certain locations. Moon gave an example of specific items that deal more damage against Murloc enemies, and that players might want to have more gear tailored to fighting against a Murloc boss in a raid encounter.

Forever's raids will feature multiple distinct biomes within them, Moon revealed, giving players more factors to consider when choosing what gear to use for specific parts of each raid. One wing of a raid may be snowy, while another may be cavernous, changing what gear could be more optimal for those encounters.

"I think your BiS should be different [for] every single boss if you're actually making a theoretical BiS list," Moon said. "It should be based on the creature and the biome and a mixture of those two. You might have an item that's really good against snowy, and then another item in that same slot that's really good against Murlocs. Then there's a Murloc boss in a snowy area and you're just like 'Which one do I wear?' And then eventually you get to a point where you're swapping those things out or it's too much cognitive load and you don't want to do that. It's for those players that really want to optimize."

Trying to get rid of BiS lists is a big change for WoW, which has revolved around the idea for over two decades. Players can already encounter some of the itemization ideas Moon discussed while leveling to 60, with low-level gear from dungeons and quests dealing more damage against specified enemy types or even granting additional movement speed in specific zones.
"I don't want you to have to ever think about BiS, I just want you to think about the fight right in front of you and how you're going to fight it," Moon said.

Of course, having more biome- or enemy-type-specific items means hoarding more pieces of gear as opposed to selling old ones when an upgrade comes around. That will no doubt quickly fill up the inventories and banks of players looking to min-max for every possible scenario. Classic WoW is already notorious for having limited bag space, and players running around with multiple sets of hyper-specific gear will only make that pain point worse.

Blizzard sounds like it's aware of that problem. Principal game designer Kris Zierhut said bigger bags are on that way, but that it's not needed right now immediately post-launch. However, Blizzard knows players will eventually need more bag space as well as better ways to organize and search for owned items to make putting together encounter-specific sets of gear easier.

It's a massive change, but the strategy Blizzard is employing seems to be working. Forever's launch broke WoW concurrent and weekly player records , and more than 15 million characters have been created in the MMO so far. Blizzard recently lifted the veil on how Forever's new PvP system will work , revealing how classic WoW's infamous rank grind will now be a thing of the past.

news.title: 育碧正在进行更多大规模裁员，影响其最大的两个工作室
news.summary: Ubisoft has enacted another round of mass layoffs, affecting 166 additional jobs as the French gaming giant co

others.title: 育碧正在解雇其最大的两个工作室的员工

content.v: Ubisoft has enacted another round of mass layoffs, affecting 166 additional jobs as the French gaming giant continues its cost-cutting program.

The job cuts are happening at two of Ubisoft's biggest development hubs in Montreal and Quebec. A spokesperson for Ubisoft said the job cuts are coming to meet changing production needs, and IGN reported that the layoffs came from teams working on projects that have been "canceled or refocused."

"We deeply value the contributions of these teams and recognise the impact this may have on our colleagues. We are committed to supporting them through this process with care and respect," the spokesperson said. "Those affected are being provided with severance, extended health care benefits, career transition services and other resources."

Ubisoft Montreal is currently working on Assassin's Creed Codename Hexe , while Ubisoft Quebec most recently launched Assassin's Creed Shadows. No further updates are coming to that game, leaving the question of what the team is making next.
In October, Ubisoft said there are no additional Assassin's Creed remakes currently in development , following the release of Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag Resynced earlier this year.
“Our teams are already focused on the next chapter of Assassin’s Creed titles, including projects you haven’t heard about yet, featuring new settings and stories," the developer said.

Ubisoft's restructuring has led to several canceled games, shut-down studios, and layoffs. Trials developer RedLynx is on the chopping block , while 72 people from Ubisoft Singapore–the studio behind Skull & Bones–were recently laid off .

Just today, November 19, Ubisoft released its latest earnings report that mentioned that Ubisoft's third phase of its cost-reduction program remains "firmly on track." Ubisoft is targeting €1.25 billion ($1.37 billion) in cost reductions by March 2028, so it's possible there will be more pain in the company's future.

news.title: 《GTA 6》的杰森和露西亚演员打破多年的沉默发表新的联合声明
news.summary: GTA 6's lead actors, Dylan Rourke and Manni L. Perez, have broken their multi-year streak of silence about bei

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/19/image-c755c61e-1fe7-450f-ba86-76b5f1ac6044-1795117431730.png
GTA 6's lead actors, Dylan Rourke and Manni L. Perez , have broken their multi-year streak of silence about starring in the game.

With GTA 6 officially being out now, the game's full cast has officially been announced . Rockstar kept the actors under a veil of secrecy for the better part of a decade, though some fans were able to figure out who they were thanks to some sleuthing. Still, despite this, the actors maintained strong poker faces, and it's honestly commendable how well they kept their roles under wraps. To celebrate the game's launch, Rourke (who plays Jason) and Perez (who plays Lucia) released a joint statement on their Instagram accounts about their experience working on the game.

"Years witnessing the hardest working and most skilled artisans game making has to offer," reads their statement. "We are truly honored to collaborate on this worldwide testament to human creativity, ingenuity, and sheer willpower. So much learned and so much to learn, keep fighting for what you love, stay humble. See y’all in Leonida."

Perez's role was technically confirmed earlier this week when she was nominated for Best Performance at The Game Awards. Jason and Lucia have been receiving all kinds of praise for their hyper-detailed relationship, which allows players to roleplay a romantic and nuanced kinship. There hasn't really been anything quite like it in gaming, though that has also led to some annoyance from a certain group of fans who just want a straight-up crime game without the lovey-dovey fluff.

Still, there is plenty of crime to be found in this game, obviously. GTA 6's sketchy cast of characters is supported by plenty of new, up-and-coming talent along with some more familiar faces like Bobby Moynihan and Stephen Root ( who leaked his own role earlier this year ). Whether this will catapult Perez and Rourke into more mainstream roles following GTA 6 remains to be seen. GTA 5's Steven Ogg (who played Trevor) was cast in shows like The Walking Dead and Better Call Saul following the game's release. Given GTA 6 is likely going to have the biggest launch in entertainment history, these two actors are about to become some of the most recognizable faces and voices in gaming.

news.title: 毛茸茸的社区因 GTA 6 恶搞而分裂
news.summary: Furries are at odds as to whether or not GTA 6's satirical take on anti-Furry sentiment is harmful to public p

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/19/gta6-furries-blogroll-1795117217714.jpg
Warning: Mild spoilers for a GTA 6 below!
The Grand Theft Auto franchise is known for parodying aspects of American culture, but one particular bit of satire in GTA 6 is causing a divide in the Furry community.

In the fictional world of GTA 6 , being a Furry is illegal. In fact, licensed hunters in Leonida — GTA’s tongue-in-cheek take on Florida — are authorized to “shoot any Furry on sight.” Of course, it’s obvious that the developers at Rockstar were merely poking fun at recent anti-Furry sentiment from the likes of Florida governor Ron DeSantis , but some real-life Furries are worried that this satire might be taken literally by young players.

For instance, a public service announcement from the “Anti-Furry Association" plays on a television channel in the game warning players about the supposed “dangers” of furries, reminding them that “all citizens are required to report any suspicious activity.” This includes phrases and slang that are popular within the Furry community, like “Uwu, Rawr XD,” and “Hewwo.”

Scrolling through the game’s social media apps, players will also come across a news article from the Vice City Horn titled, “Governor Declares Leonida Furry-Free.” Its headline is accompanied by an image of a crying Furry peeking out from behind a red ‘no’ symbol.

The most viral facet in this conversation concerns an in-game event that players come upon at night. In this event, police are in a standoff with a Furry, who taunts the cops training their guns on him as helicopters fly overhead. Players can choose to help save the Furry from law enforcement or watch him get riddled with bullets if they don’t feel like coming to his rescue.

Some members of the Furry community aren’t taking it too seriously. On X/Twitter, where the bulk of this debate is taking place, a Furry user by the name Freaking_Flynn wrote , “I love it, but I feel like this joke would fit more in the Saints Row series than in the world of GTA. But anywho, Furries going mainstream!”

“I can't believe this is real, and I unironically love it,” another Furry netizen named Riley said of the game’s Furry encounter. Commenters beneath their post seem largely in agreement, with many pointing out how the fictional Furry taunted officers to “suck his knot.”

Others, however, are worried about the broader message GTA 6’s satirical take on anti-Furry panic might color public perception of the community. On Twitter, a Furry user named Kineon wrote , “I love GTA and understand this is meant as satire. However, as a Florida-based furry who already deals with regular hate and threats, I’m genuinely concerned that this could end up encouraging more real-world hostility and violence toward us."

“I get this game is supposed to be satire.. But to be blatantly honest... This is just encouraging more hatred, as well as allowing people who don't like Furries to encourage bad intentions, such as actually shooting one in-person,” another Furry user named Venus said . “Considering the fact that there are children who play this series and are being encouraged to do illegal crimes (which yes, it's a video game but still) it's not exactly healthy for such things to be promoted.”

I had the privilege of speaking with a member of the Furry community to get their opinion on the matter. Riley — whose comments we included earlier in this article — elaborated on how they felt about being represented in GTA 6, saying they believe most Furries understand the joke and are generally appreciative of being referenced in one of the biggest pop culture moments of the decade.

“I think speaking on behalf of the furry community can be a little tricky, because we're definitely a community that can be quick to jump on a bandwagon and criticize opinions we disagree with. But in this particular case, I genuinely think most furries understand that it's a joke and are actually really happy to be acknowledged in such a massive cultural moment as the release of GTA 6,” they told me.

“There's something genuinely hilarious about furries being ‘banned’ in Leonida, especially when you consider that the game also gives players the opportunity to help these furries escape from the police and reach a hideout,” they continued. “It's exactly the kind of ridiculous social satire that GTA has always been known for, and I think most of us appreciate being included in it, even if we're technically the butt of the joke!

“I also think there's something really special about furry culture being represented in a game this massive. Whether Rockstar intended it or not, GTA 6 will probably introduce millions of people to the fandom and, unironically, might even inspire an entirely new generation of future furries. Which honestly makes the whole situation even funnier to me.”

Ultimately, Riley felt this situation doesn’t need to “become a serious debate” about the Furry community; instead, it’s just another example of how Rockstar reflects modern American culture in GTA games with “its signature, over-the-top humor.”

I also reached out to SonicFox , one of the world's best professional fighting game players and a notable member of the Furry community, who shared a similar sentiment. "I think it’s clearly satire and very apparent what political group GTA is making fun of," they told me.

news.title: 尽管《GTA 6》是有史以来最成功的游戏之一，但开发人员仍然担心裁员
news.summary: GTA 6 is already an incredibly successful game, and when the dust settles, it'll likely end up as one of the m

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/19/ultimate-edition-goodtime-gear-01-1782295792418-1795067565426.jpg

GTA 6 is already an incredibly successful game, and when the dust settles, it'll likely end up as one of the most lucrative entertainment releases of all time. Yet some of the developers are still worried that layoffs are lurking around the corner.

GTA 6 is already tied for the best-reviewed game of all time with the original Ocarina of Time, and it's already broken streaming records on Twitch . It'll be a while yet before we get any kind of precise data on how well the game sold, but going off of preorder info , it's going to rake in a ton of money. Despite all of that, Rockstar devs are still worried that layoffs could put a damper on their celebrations.

Rockstar Animation Programmer Nestor Uriarte wrote an opinion piece for The Guardian ahead of the Rockstar union recognition vote. He spent a lot of his time in his op-ed making the case for unionization in the games industry, at one point pointing out, "While the highs of a game release like this can be incredible, game workers have also come to expect other, less welcome side effects: intense overtime in the buildup and mass redundancies in the aftermath."

Uriarte acknowledges that there isn't any indication that layoffs are actually coming, but it's not hard to see why Rockstar devs would be nervous now that the game is out. 2026 has been littered with layoffs. Just today, Ubisoft cut 166 jobs from its Montreal and Quebec offices . Xbox, too, has been notorious for job cuts this year , as CEO Asha Sharma attempts to "reset" the company . Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella has even cheered on these job cuts , saying they're "great to see."

In his piece, Uriarte also says the Rockstar team is worried about the role that AI will play in the industry going forward. Back in March, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick laughed off the notion that someone could create a game at the same scale and quality as GTA 6 with a simple prompt, but he did acknowledge in that same interview that some AI tools are still helpful for game creation.

For their part, Rockstar developers want protection from being replaced from those kinds of tools. According to Uriarte's piece, "Across the [gaming] sector, the skills that workers spend years developing risk being devalued as their creative work is replaced by AI. Rockstar has said it is committed to preserving jobs and it has been clear that our games will continue to be made by people. But with recognition we’d have a seat at the table to manage this industry-wide transition together."

The vote for recognition of the IWGB union at Rockstar is currently underway and runs until November 26. If it's successful, would end up being the biggest recognized union in U.K. games history. The unionization effort has been contentious, too, after Rockstar fired dozens of staff members, leading to accusations of union busting .

克劳德·斯特莱夫 (Cloud Strife) 已成为游戏界最知名的面孔之一，多年来，她加入了《王国之心》、《任天堂明星大乱斗》甚至《万智牌》等游戏中。他的标志性破坏剑几乎和他现在一样具有标志性。

news.title: 想要开始有效地举重吗？ GTA 6 是一位好老师
news.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here, and people are discovering all manner of little details in the

content.v: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here, and people are discovering all manner of little details in the game that speak to the developer's commitment to realism. One such detail is the game's weightlifting and general fitness systems, and they seem to be pretty great, so much so that if you're thinking about getting into weight lifting, GTA 6's lessons are a good place to start.

For starters, Jason has a home gym, and that's just smart on his part. Not having to leave your house and head to a gym is a godsend for anyone short on time or for those who simply enjoy the solitude of slinging weight around alone. For Jason, it's even better--he lives on the water, and it looks pretty damn serene heading to his workout pad for a sweat.

If you're thinking about crafting your own home gym, Jason's setup is exactly what you need to get started: a squat rack, bench, kettlebells, barbells, and iron plates. Garage gym expert Cooper Mitchell also pointed out that Jason's squat stand uses 3"x3" uprights with 1" holes, and that's a great choice by Jason--or you--because it means you have universal support for other attachments from different brands that you might add over time.

Jason also has his setup outfitted with horse stall mats , which is another super-smart choice on his part, not only to protect his flooring, but also because they hold up in the outdoor setting that he uses. Having personally invested in horse stall mats for my own home gym, I can vouch for their incredibly sturdy makeup. They are far better than the cheap interlocking styrofoam mats. They cost more and are a massive pain in the ass to get in place due to their weight and structure. But that's just how it is.

I am a little concerned about Jason leaving all of this equipment outdoors, considering it rains a lot in Florida and is very humid. This may not be ideal for his iron plates, specifically, or his rack. That being said, Jason (and Lucia) can also work out at an indoor gym, so they have their bases covered.

Moving beyond the equipment, GTA 6 really nails the details on how to actually build muscle. To maximize your gains, first you need to use proper form. If Jason does not gently lower the bar on chest presses, he fails his reps, and that's basically how it works in real life. Making slow, controlled movements with any free weight is good practice, and it's nice to see the game reinforce this by giving you a fail state when you move the weight too quickly or in an uncontrolled manner. Of course, you can pack on muscle with bad form and so-called "ego-lifting," but it's generally more advisable to focus on your form. Making light weight feel heavy is the real path to gains.

After hitting chest, doing squats, or swinging the kettlebell, GTA 6 encourages you to eat some protein to lock in your gains, and that's also how it works in real life. You can lift all you want, but if you're not eating enough protein, you won't progress optimally. In GTA 6, your protein intake can come in the form of shakes and bars that Jason has at home, or he can head out into the world and grab a bite that way. You also need to rest to feel your best and see the most improvements to your physique in GTA 6, and that's also good advice in real life. When you're in the act of lifting, you're tearing your muscles apart to make them grow back bigger via hypertrophy, but the actual muscle growth happens during rest and sleep.

GTA 6 goes even further with its own dedicated fitness app on your phone that tracks your progress and serves as a reminder to stay, as the kids say, locked in. This is great, and another solid replication of the experience you might have with your own fitness app or watch. A word to the wise, though: Do not get too obsessed with tracking your macros and workouts in the game or in your personal life. Life is meant to be lived and enjoyed, even if it means you're not in "optimal" shape. Your health and fitness journey is personal to you. So go eat a donut and drink a beer at the same time like Jason does . You do not need to have 8% body fat like Take-Two's own CEO Strauss Zelnick does. Enjoy your life, in Vice City and out, but if you want some tips on how to get started, GTA 6 offers a solid foundation to build from.

news.title: 你可以使用这种极其复杂的方法以 60fps 玩 Grand Theft Auto 6
news.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI is finally out for consoles, and it's every bit the visual showcase of the generation that

content.v: Grand Theft Auto VI is finally out for consoles, and it's every bit the visual showcase of the generation that it was promising to be since its reveal. You'll struggle to find a better-looking game on the current generation of hardware, but one concession Rockstar had to make to achieve that was limiting its frame rate--a limitation some players are going to absurd lengths to overcome.

Irrespective of what platform you play on, Grand Theft Auto VI is limited to 30fps. Doubling that to the more desirable 60fps is something current console hardware just isn't capable of with this level of visual fidelity and simulation, which means you'll have to rely on other methods of frame generation to get there. That's the idea that underpins technology like Veyra : an open-source real-time video enhancer that uses your PC and HDMI 2.1 capture card to bring frame generation to your console.

It's a...complicated process. First you'll need a capable capture card (like one of the many from Elgato) that is able to ingest gameplay at 4K over HDMI 2.1. You'll need to connect that to your PC using certified USB-C 3.2 data cable, which needs to plug into a suitable motherboard with True USB 3.2 Gen 2 support. On the pricier end of the requirements, you will need a relatively powerful GPU, with the creators recommending a RTX-40 or newer card from Nvidia in order to tap into the card's Tensor cores (that are used for frame generation on PC). Pair that with an OLED monitor, which is also strongly recommended thanks to its near-instant pixel response times, and you've got everything you need to finally enjoy Grand Theft Auto VI (and more) at higher frame rates.

Veyra is able to take gameplay captured on your console and apply a variety of enhancements over the footage, which is ultimately displayed (and played) through the PC you're capturing the footage to. You can utilize upscaling and frame generation techniques from Nvidia, AMD, and Intel to enhance both the resolution and perceived fluidity of your console games this way, with as minimal latency as possible. Given all the parts in the chain, from your console, to the capture card, and through to your PC, escaping any additional latency is impossible. But Verya is seemingly built with mitigating latency as its highest priority, and seems to achieve that based on feedback from some users on Reddit .

Is it worth it to go through this much hassle to play GTA 6 at 60fps? If you have all the required hardware then it's at least worth a shot, even just for the sake of curiosity. But actually investing in a setup to achieve this is probably overkill. For starters, it requires a PC that will probably be capable enough to play Rockstar's latest sequel at or on-par with the console version once it does land on PC (which will reportedly be sooner than you think). Capture cards are not outrageously expensive, but they're also not free, which can also be said for all the high-quality cables you'll need between each of the three required devices.

I admit, I admire the dedication to playing Grand Theft Auto VI at launch in the best possible way, but I would wager that you're likely going to be spending a lot more time troubleshooting some incompatibility somewhere along this chain of dependencies instead of enjoying the game itself. Still, if you're curious you can find a lot of detailed information about what this setup requires and why, and determine for yourself if it's worth the price to cruise around Leonida with a bit more fluidity.

news.title: GTA 6 是 Twitch 和 Kick 有史以来最受欢迎的游戏，而且仅发布一天

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/18/gta6-review-blogroll-1794996674466.jpg
GTA 6 has, perhaps unsurprisingly, become the most popular game on Twitch and Kick in the history of both streaming platforms within just the first 26 hours of its global release.

GTA 6 officially launched worldwide on November 19. However, oodles of players were already going on virtual crime sprees in Leonida well before then thanks to ‘ the New Zealand trick ,’ which allowed them to access the game in the early morning hours of November 18 by switching their consoles to the region.

In just 26 hours, Rockstar’s latest Grand Theft Auto installment has already broken records, becoming the most popular game in both Twitch and Kick history with a combined 1.28 million hours of total broadcast time.

This statistic comes from two separate reports created by Streamlabs and Streamscharts, platforms that aggregate streaming data across the net’s top broadcasting services. Both platforms confirmed that GTA 6 has already enjoyed more than 118 million hours watched as of November 19, with Streamlabs noting this number is 9.7 times greater than hours watched on Just Chatting (12.2 million hours), Twitch’s next most-watched streaming category and a catch-all for broadcasters doing most activities that aren’t strictly gaming.

Thus far, GTA 6 has boasted a peak concurrent viewership of more than 7.25 million viewers across all tracked platforms, with an average of 4.03 million concurrent viewers and 1.28 million hours of total broadcast airtime. Top streamers for the game included Twitch streamers alanzoka, Rubios, and Honeymad, with IShowSpeed and Gameplayrj also in the Top 5 on YouTube Gaming.

Streamscharts, however, paints a far more impressive picture, finding that GTA 6 has crossed more than 125 million hours watched across Kick, YouTube, and Twitch. (Unsurprisingly, Twitch led viewership with 52 million hours watched on its platform.) Streamscharts also noted that IShowSpeed ranked as the most-watched streamer for GTA 6 overall with 4.47M hours watched, while Spanish influencer IlloJuan drew the largest single-stream peak at 562K viewers.

Also in Streamscharts' report was confirmation that GTA 6 has officially become the most popular game ever on both Twitch and Kick in just its first day, breaking single-day watch-time records on both platforms.

This data follows another report from Streamscharts that was published yesterday, which found that GTA 6 had already overtaken Valorant’s 2020 Twitch record of 1.7 million concurrent viewers during its closed beta. This report also found that GTA 6 has already accrued “more than 1,500 years of nonstop viewing.”

IGN got the chance to speak with Twitch about GTA 6’s imminent release to see how the platform was preparing for the most popular game in history. Twitch’s Head of Community Marketing, Mary Kish, revealed that the company had been making plans for the launch “well over six months ago,” saying at the time that “the GTA tsunami is going to hit us like a ton of bricks and we have to mentally and physically prepare everybody. All hands on deck, every chef in the kitchen.”

news.title: 杰森在日版 GTA 6 中只穿内衣洗澡，但审查制度对于 Rockstar Games 来说并不是什么新鲜事
news.summary: GTA 6 is finally here, but for players in Japan the experience is looking a bit different. Pre-release concern

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/19/vintage-vice-city-pack-exclusive-looks-01-1795113789423.jpg

GTA 6 is finally here, but for players in Japan the experience is looking a bit different. Pre-release concerns about censorship have proven to be founded, with blood, gore, and nudity getting dialed down, but also some more surprising changes.

One difference in the Japanese version that’s quickly attracted attention is nudity censorship. But one change in particular is drawing puzzled and disappointed reactions. In most versions of the game, you can see Jason’s naked back and bottom when he takes a shower. However, in the Japanese version, black underwear now mostly covers his butt. Nude beachgoers have also been given underwear.
日本の表現規制のクソっぷりが全世界に知れ渡ってめちゃくちゃ気分が良い もっと燃やせ

“GTA 6 takes place in such a realistic world, but I hate how this sloppy, out-of-place censorship breaks my immersion.” commented one X user in Japanese. Although Japan has censored full-frontal nudity in games before (such as by adding strategically placed figleaves in Baldur’s Gate 3), a brief glimpse of someone’s bottom has previously been allowed. In Death Stranding, for example, you can see Sam’s bare bottom in the shower, even in the Japanese version.

Japanese news site Game*Spark also spotted some noticeable differences in gore between GTA6’s Japanese and Western releases. In the display settings menu, you can toggle Blood & Gore Intensity on a scale of low to high. The Japanese release completely removes this option. Although bloodstains remain on the ground and on people’s clothing in the Japanese version, there is far less blood compared to Western versions, suggesting that the Japanese version is locked at a lower gore intensity.

However, the Japanese version does still have the option to toggle dismemberment on or off, although it’s toned down compared to GTA 6 in other regions. Japan’s CERO ratings board has previously called on game developers to censor or even remove dismemberment and decapitation in the past. As Game*Spark noted, “Jason wears underwear in the shower but can still blow people’s heads off.”

CERO (Computer Entertainment Rating Organization) is Japan’s age rating board for video games. Although games can be released on digital storefronts with a rating from the IARC instead, a CERO rating is required for 18+ games and physical releases. GTA 6 received a Z (18+) certificate, CERO’s highest rating. To get a CERO rating, a game has to be submitted for review on each of the platforms it will be released on, making the rating process for multiplatform games potentially time consuming and costly (source: Automaton ). If the game fails to pass the first review, the developer must make changes based on CERO’s comments and resubmit. In this case, Jason’s shower underwear might be a result of Rockstar being extra cautious in making sure GTA 6 could get a CERO certification in time for a smooth, worldwide release.

Prior to GTA 6’s launch, fans were already concerned that the Japanese version would be heavily censored. Japan’s PS5 and Xbox store pages only show CERO content warning icons for violence and crime, in contrast to overseas release ratings. Conversely, North America’s ESRB mentions strong sexual content and nudity, among other content warnings.

Other Rockstar games have received similar censorship in Japan. In GTA 5, for example, sex scenes were cut and most of the torture section got axed. Red Dead Redemption 1 and 2 had nudity and sex scenes removed and reduced gory details (especially in RDR2’s American Dreams mission). LA Noire also had nudity censored, with the naked bodies in the homicide cases partially covered by blankets.

Some Japanese users who are unhappy with the censorship have tried downloading overseas versions. However, one big issue is that only the Japanese release offers Japanese language support. “Ugh, forget it… I’ll study English and buy the North American version,” one Japanese user reacted . However, if GTA 6 ever comes to PC, Japanese gamers may get a version that is closer to Western releases, as CERO ratings are not required for PC games.
